facility.name: The Little Engine Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4122 AVENIDA PRIMA ST, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78233

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities: Children were observed coming from the playground outside and not washing their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director last completed transportation training on 7/4/2025.  She completed the transportation training today on 8/13/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The toilet in the school-age restroom was backed up due to another child clogging it with toilet paper.  There was also feces in the toilet that emitted a smell of feces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One out of seven staff files reviewed had a CPR certificate that expired on 10.12.2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One out of seven staff files reviewed had a First Aid certificate that expired on 10.12.2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Two out of eight children's files reviewed did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The depth of the loose fill under the swings at the big playground was less than an inch. The depth of the loose fill at the merry-go-round in the toddler playgound was one inch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three of ten children's records reviewed did not have current immunization records in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant classroom was over ratio by one infant. The specified age group was 8 months and 5 infants were being supervised by one caregiver.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when one infant was moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of ten children's records reviewed did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregivers in the infant classroom gave incorrect number of children in the classroom.  Caregivers stated there were six  infants when there were seven infants.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver confirmed an additional child had been dropped off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The afterschool outdoor play area had a rusted play tub with rusted bolts, a leaning fun hoop funnel and gap in the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Six cribs had loose sheets covering the crib mattresses.   Note: This was corrected at inspection when caregivers replaced sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Three classrooms had a fan on top of children's cubbies unsecured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: There was no documentation that monthly maintenance checklists were completed.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the Director conducted an inspection of the active play areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights: During the inspection the director stated that the Provider's Guide to Parent's Rights had not been passed out to parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation has not certified that they have reviewed each of the recall notices issued by the CPSC and that there are no unsafe products in the center. This was corrected at inspection when the second director filled out the Children's Products Certification form and signed it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: Fire extinguishers are not current on their checks. This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted a fire extinguisher check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website: The operation does not have the Children's Products Certification form posted. This was corrected at inspection when the second director posted the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The gas inspection was due 9/30/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two children in the infant room, who are not yet on table food, did not have current feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: The medication drawer had a prescription that was two years old. This was corrected at inspection with the director disposed of the medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  -Gates Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked: Recite- Swimming pool gate was missing the self lock mechanism.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  -Gates Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked (26 TAC §746.5007(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Based on the evidence and interviews conducted it was determined that the operation served a meal that was unsafe and unsanitary to consume.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  -Gates Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked: Swimming pool gate was missing the self lock mechanism.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fencing Around Swimming Pool  -Gates Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked (26 TAC §746.5007(b))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: The vehicle used to transport children did not have working Child Safety Alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: Three push toys were found worn off and broken in the toddler playground. Broken toys that were going to be discarded were found accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A staff member's purse in the infant classroom was sitting on a filing cabinet in reach of children.     Note: This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Wood fence used as a barrier for the outdoor air conditioner was found broken and unanchored in the  playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Operation policies were missing the time durations, and benefits, of how the operation will be promoting indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two classroom  are currently being used for storage and not maintained as licensed space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: A sanitiation inspection was not conducted for the previous year. The last inspection conducted was 11/19/2021
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: There wasn't a copy of the most recent fire inspection report on file or posted at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: The operation did not share infant daily reports with the parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: 2 out of the 8 staff records reviewed were missing training on the topic of administering medication
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted in the school age room.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director printed and posted one in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of the 10 children's files reviewed were missing current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: There have been no monthly building and grounds checks conducted for the current calender year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: There was a single staple found on the bounce and play tray area in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Three infant feeding logs were not current for the month of December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
